:::{#def-pair-encoding}
#### Pair encoding

Let $w$ and $x$ be binary strings.
Their **pair encoding** $\angb{w, x}$ is the binary string made of
each digit of $w$ written twice,
then $01$,
then $x$.
A machine can recover $w$ and $x$ from $\angb{w, x}$
by reading two digits at a time until it reads $01$.
@arora2009computational [section 0.1] use a variant that also doubles the digits of $x$.

:::
